note: Node.js feature: LRU cache gains peek(), ttl with injected clock, onEvict callback; tests already written
prompt: This Node.js package is a small LRU cache. The test file test/lru.test.js already contains tests for new behaviour that is not implemented yet: `peek`, a `ttl` option (default and per-entry, with an injectable `now` clock) and an `onEvict(key, value, reason)` callback. Run `node --test` from the repository root to see the failures. Implement the feature in the non-test source so the whole suite passes. The test files are the specification: do not edit, delete or skip any test (they are restored and hash-checked before grading). Keep the change focused. Report briefly what you changed.
